---
title: Typst bibliography
bibliography: ../../bibliography.bib
bibliography-title: Literature
bibliographystyle: chicago-author-date
format:
  preprint-typst:
    keep-typ: true
    citeproc: false
expect:
  contains:
    - "Literature"
    - "(R Core Team 2025)"
  absent:
    - "References"
---

With `citeproc: false`, Typst formats the citations and the reference list [@rcoreteamLanguageEnvironmentStatistical2025]. The list has a custom title and uses the Chicago author-date style, so citations have no comma before the year. @allaireQuarto2025 is cited in text.
